verdict.rationale: Wise's card APIs document per-card spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe) and spend-control rules based on merchant category code or transaction currency, which covers the granular-controls half of the story. However, the evidence never mentions amount-based spend limits. The controls are also documented as Platform APIs for partners' customers' cards, not as a Wise Business dashboard for assigning cards to employees. Missing for 10: documented per-card monetary spend limits, an employee-level card assignment and management workflow for finance leads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee

citations.quote: Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
